title: Burton Cummings Theatre
geometryBasis: Named 17-vertex mapped footprint of the brick auditorium and right-angled entrance at 364 Smith Street. The Canadian Register identifies the building components and fly-tower dimension.
sectionBasis: The July 2014 exterior photo controls the canopy, sign and plain brick flank. The public heritage record controls the stone arch, cornice and blind windows.
limitations: The model represents the Burton Cummings Theatre on July 30, 2014, including the Smith Street entrance and the attached brick auditorium and stage block.

The exact Qualla photograph controls the side of the marquee, vertical green sign, and buff auditorium brick. The heritage designation records the limestone arch, third-floor blind windows and modillion cornice. Rear exit locations, tower placement and ornament profiles are reconstructed estimates.
The original elevation field is preserved. Contact follows approximate pavement at the theatre entrance.
